ana (People Ops): one-minute manager goal template for quick alignment before the review cycle. paste into kickoff or 1:1.

ana (People Ops): Template:
Objective (1 line): <outcome>
Owner: <name>
Top 3 signals (one-line each):
  1) <metric/artifact + baseline -> target>
  2) <artifact link or number>
  3) <customer quote or dashboard>
Next deliverable (owner + due date + effort: small/med/large)
Manager ask (one sentence): <what owner needs this week>
Check-in cadence: weekly / bi-weekly / async

kevin (eng-manager): perfect for my sprint planning slot. adding a tiny upward feedback prompt: "One thing you want your manager to stop/start/continue"

rachel (product): Nice. Suggest adding a short success sentence: "What 'done' looks like for users"

ana (People Ops): added. snippets-bot:Pinned to #people-ops-resources and added copy to handbook.
